newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sapporo Breweries 96 profit almost unchanged - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sapporo Breweries 96 profit almost unchanged - paper.

text.p: Sapporo Breweries Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of 14.5 billion yen in calendar 1996, up about one percent from its actual profit in the previous year but 3.5 billion yen less than the company's forecast, a Japanese business daily said on Friday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that the company's current profit in 1997 was expected to rise seven percent year on year from 1996.
The paper said that Sapporo would not be able to meet its profit forecast for the year to December 31, 1996, partly because its beer sales fell two percent year on year.
It said that Sapporo's beer sales were seen rising five percent year on year in 1997.
Sapporo was not immediately available for comment.
